sentences.en: Young men have drifted toward Donald Trump, while young women are surging toward Kamala
sentences.zh: 年轻男性倾向于唐纳德·特朗普，而年轻女性则激增投向卡马拉

sentences.en: Harris.

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Claire Kane Miller on a divide that is defining this election.

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.

sentences.en: I'm glad to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: So you've been doing a lot of reporting on young people, and you've identified something very interesting among these young people and how they vote.
sentences.zh: 所以你一直在对年轻人进行大量报道，并且你发现这群年轻人及其投票方式之间有一些非常有趣的东西。

sentences.en: Tell me about that reporting.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲那篇报道吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So I covered gender from a data perspective, and we started to see something really surprising
sentences.zh: 我从数据的角度报道了性别议题，我们开始在这个选举周期中看到一些

sentences.en: this election cycle, which is that the difference between how young men and young women are voting is really growing much larger than it has been in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 非常令人惊讶的现象，那就是年轻男性和年轻女性在投票选择上的差距，确实比以往任何时候都要大得多。

sentences.en: And explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: What does that gap look like?
sentences.zh: 这个差距是什么样的？

sentences.en: So in general, women are more likely to vote Democratic than men.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，女性比男性更有可能投票给民主党。

sentences.en: But in most age groups, the difference is pretty small.
sentences.zh: 但在大多数年龄段中，这种差异其实很小。

sentences.en: Among the youngest voters, which means 18 to 29-year-olds, it's really big this time around, bigger than for any older age group.
sentences.zh: 但在最年轻的选民中，也就是18到29岁的人群，这次差距真的很大，比任何年长年龄段都要大。

sentences.en: Young men are, a small majority of them, planning to vote for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 年轻男性中，有一小部分多数人计划投票给唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: That has not necessarily generally been true of young people.
sentences.zh: 这在过去不一定普遍适用于年轻人。

sentences.en: The majority of young people voted for Biden, no matter their gender.
sentences.zh: 不论性别，大多数年轻人过去都投票给了拜登。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You think of young people as being pretty progressive.
sentences.zh: 你觉得年轻人相当进步。

sentences.en: You do in general, and they are.
sentences.zh: 总体而言你确实会这么想，他们也确实如此。

sentences.en: But this time, polls are showing something different for young men.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，民调显示年轻男性的情况有所不同。

sentences.en: Just over half of them appear to be voting for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 略过半数的人似乎打算投票给唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, two-thirds or more of young women are planning to vote for Kamala Harris, which is a bigger share than any other group by age or gender.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，三分之二或更多的年轻女性正计划投票给卡马拉·哈里斯，这一比例比任何其他按年龄或性别划分的群体都要高。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So you have this kind of new gap that was not true for young people, say, a generation ago.
sentences.zh: 所以你发现了这种新差距，这在比如上一代人的年轻人身上是不存在的。

sentences.en: Or even an election ago.
sentences.zh: 甚至在上一次大选中也没有。

sentences.en: And the really fascinating thing is that the biggest change has been among young women.
sentences.zh: 而真正令人着迷的是，变化最大的是年轻女性。

sentences.en: They have always leaned left.
sentences.zh: 她们一直倾向于左翼。

sentences.en: But just in the last eight years, they have begun leaning left much more than they had been before.
sentences.zh: 但就在过去八年里，她们向左倾斜的程度比以往任何时候都要大得多。

sentences.en: It's a really sharp rise in their liberal identification, which political scientists told me, you don't really see this kind of change so quickly among a group of people.
sentences.zh: 她们的自由派认同度出现了急剧上升，政治学家告诉我，你很少看到一个群体发生如此迅速的变化。

sentences.en: And it's true of all young women.
sentences.zh: 而且所有年轻女性都是如此。

sentences.en: There's no difference by education, even though education usually affects how people vote.
sentences.zh: 教育程度之间没有区别，尽管教育通常会影响人们的投票方式。

sentences.en: There's no difference by race.
sentences.zh: 种族之间也没有区别。

sentences.en: Really, when you look at young women in America today, across categories, they're moving left.
sentences.zh: 真的，当你审视当今美国的年轻女性时，跨越各个类别，她们都在向左转。

sentences.en: And what about men?
sentences.zh: 那男性呢？

sentences.en: So men are moving somewhat to the right.
sentences.zh: 男性则在一定程度上向右转。

sentences.en: It's been a little overblown, this idea that all young men are backing Trump.
sentences.zh: “所有年轻男性都在支持特朗普”这种说法被稍微夸大了。

sentences.en: But there has been some movement to the right.

sentences.en: Got it.

sentences.en: So for women, it's just everybody.
sentences.zh: 所以对于女性来说，基本上所有人都在变。

sentences.zh: 但对于男性来说，变化主要只发生在那些没上过大学的小伙子身上。

sentences.en: For the most part.
sentences.zh: 大部分是这样。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So this is incredibly interesting to me, Claire.
sentences.zh: 克莱尔，这对我来说太有趣了。

sentences.en: As you know, a former and recovering demographics reporter.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我曾是一名人口统计记者，现在也在恢复中。

sentences.en: It's also kind of a mystery, right?
sentences.zh: 这也算是一个谜，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, what is going on here?
sentences.zh: 比如，这里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: What is driving this difference in this kind of, you know, new demographic political tree ring, if you will?
sentences.zh: 是什么在推动这种差异，以及这种可以说是全新的民主政治年轮？

sentences.en: How did these two groups come to be so far apart?
sentences.zh: 这两个群体怎么会变得如此疏远？

sentences.en: on how men and women are coming into adulthood, this 18 to 29-year-old age range, with really different experiences and expectations.
sentences.zh: 关于男性和女性如何进入成年期——即18到29岁的年龄段，他们带着截然不同的经历和期望。

sentences.en: It was just kind of a given that I was going to go to college.

sentences.en: I never even thought about not going to college.

sentences.en: Girls are outpacing boys in school.

sentences.en: It's true in high school and college.
sentences.zh: 高中和大学都是如此。

sentences.en: It's true as early as kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 早在幼儿园阶段就已经是这样了。

sentences.en: And their opportunities in life, the roles that they can play, really opened up from just a couple generations ago.

sentences.en: Sure.

sentences.zh: 而且他们渴望早点离开学校，去找一份能用双手做点不一样的、某种实干型的工作。

sentences.en: And this is really showing up in the data.
sentences.zh: 这一点在数据中真的体现得很明显。

sentences.en: Women are graduating from high school at higher rates than men, and they're going to college and finishing college at much higher rates too.
sentences.zh: 女性的高中毕业率比男性高，她们上大学和完成大学学业的比率也高得多。

sentences.en: And I'm assuming those worse educational outcomes for men are also affecting their job prospects, right?
sentences.zh: 我猜男性这些较差的教育成果也会影响他们的就业前景，对吧？

sentences.en: Like that's the next stage in our life cycle.
sentences.zh: 就像这是我们生命周期中的下一个阶段。

sentences.en: That's absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是真的。

sentences.en: So in this same time period, it's become much harder to earn a middle class wage without a college degree.
sentences.zh: 所以在同一时期，没有大学学历要赚到中产阶级的工资变得难得多。

sentences.en: That's particularly true for men because the jobs that men without college degrees used to do that earned them enough to support a family were largely in manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 这对男性来说尤为明显，因为没有大学学历的男性过去常常从事那些能赚到足够养家糊口的钱的工作，很大程度上都在制造业。

sentences.en: And these are the jobs that since the 1980s have really disappeared from the United States in large numbers.
sentences.zh: 而这些正是自20世纪80年代以来大量在美国消失的工作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They have either been replaced by robots or they've been sent abroad.
sentences.zh: 它们要么被机器人取代了，要么被转移到海外去了。

sentences.en: Most of my entire dad's side of the family all has worked for one of the big three.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸这边几乎所有的亲戚都在那三家汽车巨头之一工作过。

sentences.en: And my dad's told me so many stories about like, once you turn 18, you go down to Detroit in the factory and work till you get your pension.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸给我讲过好多故事，比如，你一旦满18岁，就去底特律的工厂，一直干到拿退休金。

sentences.en: And a lot of the men that I spoke to told me that their grandfathers had worked in factories, their whole couriers, and stayed there and, you know, supported a family,
sentences.zh: 我采访过的很多男性都告诉我，他们的祖父一辈子都在工厂工作，留在那里，然后，你知道的，养活了一个家庭，

sentences.en: and that they no longer had an option like that.
sentences.zh: 而他们已经没有这种选择了。

sentences.en: It definitely seemed like it was a lot more straightforward back then, where now is less clear exactly what you want to do.
sentences.zh: 过去的事情明显要明确得多，而现在你到底想做什么却没那么清晰了。

sentences.en: And I called respondents from our New York Times Siena College polls, who were young men who said they were supporting Trump.
sentences.zh: 我给《纽约时报》和锡耶纳学院民调的受访者打了电话，他们是支持特朗普的年轻男性。

sentences.en: And very interestingly to me, I could not see in that data what their jobs were, but nearly everyone I reached worked in some sort of auto job.
sentences.zh: 让我觉得非常有趣的是，我从数据中看不出他们的工作是什么，但我联系到的几乎每个人都从事某种汽车相关的工作。

sentences.en: I aligned vehicles, you know, painting cars, bumping cars.
sentences.zh: 我做车辆四轮定位，你知道的，喷汽车漆，钣金修复。

sentences.en: Either repairing cars or selling cars or doing something like that.
sentences.zh: 要么是修车，要么是卖车，或者做诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And when I asked them about it...
sentences.zh: 当我问起他们这个的时候……

sentences.en: Actually, I love my job.
sentences.zh: 其实，我很喜欢我的工作。

sentences.en: I probably could fix pretty much anything on a car.
sentences.zh: 车上的几乎所有东西我大概都能修。

sentences.en: They said that they felt like they had found jobs that were really good fits for them.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们觉得找到了非常适合自己的工作。

sentences.en: I mean, it's going to be something to focus on, something to put all my energy towards.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这会是有所专注的事情，是让我倾注所有精力的事情。

sentences.en: I'm a very hands-on person.
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常注重动手能力的人。

sentences.en: So, like, if I was, like, in a classroom just sitting down reading about this stuff, I probably would not be as proficient as I am with it.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我在教室里只是坐着读这些东西，我可能不会像现在这样熟练。

sentences.en: And yet, the jobs that are growing in the American workforce right now are so-called pink-collar jobs.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前美国劳动力市场中正在增长的工作，是所谓的粉领工作。

sentences.en: They're called that because these are the jobs that women have traditionally done.
sentences.zh: 它们之所以被称为粉领，是因为这些传统上都是女性从事的工作。

sentences.en: These are mostly jobs in the health care sector, things like home health aides or nursing assistants.
sentences.zh: 这些主要都是医疗保健行业的工作，比如家庭健康护理员或护理助理。

sentences.en: It's been really, really hard to get men to do these fast-growing jobs.
sentences.zh: 要让男性来做这些快速增长的工作，真的非常非常难。

sentences.en: They pay less.
sentences.zh: 它们的薪水较低。

sentences.en: There's a bit of a stigma around them as women's work.
sentences.zh: 周围还带有一些“这是女人做的工作”的污名。

sentences.en: During COVID and stuff, I did work as a nursing assistant with my mom.
sentences.zh: 在新冠疫情期间之类的，我确实和妈妈一起做过护理助理。

sentences.en: One of the men that we interviewed told me that he did one of these jobs for a little bit during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们采访过的一位男性告诉我，他在大流行期间短暂做过其中一份工作。

sentences.en: I hated it.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌它。

sentences.en: And he ended up, you know, in the end going back to a job in the auto industry.
sentences.zh: 结果他到头来，你知道的，又回到了汽车行业的工作。

sentences.en: So, what did this amount to then for these men when it came to their pocketbooks and being able to buy stuff and afford things?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这些男性来说，当涉及他们的钱包以及买得起东西、负担得起开销时，这到底意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: So, a lot of the men I talked to, and we've heard this throughout this election, said they were worried about economic issues.
sentences.zh: 所以，我交谈过的许多男性——我们在这次选举中也一直听到这种说法——都说他们担心经济问题。

sentences.en: I feel like it is ridiculously hard to buy anything.
sentences.zh: 我觉得买任何东西都难得离谱。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Like, groceries, I'm just in shock.
sentences.zh: 就像食品杂货，我简直震惊了。

sentences.en: We've had to raise the price of the Arizona tees, which kind of sucks.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不提高亚利桑那冰茶的价格，这感觉有点糟糕。

sentences.en: I think the last time I had to buy eggs, it was like $6.
sentences.zh: 我想我上次买鸡蛋的时候，大概是6美元。

sentences.en: Gas is expensive again.
sentences.zh: 汽油又贵了。

sentences.en: Gas was at one time like $2.18 or something.
sentences.zh: 汽油曾经一度只要2.18美元左右。

sentences.en: The other day, I was telling him, I'm like, dude, almost $4.5.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我跟他说，我说老兄，快要4.5美元了。

sentences.en: Like, what the heck?
sentences.zh: 简直搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: And when I dug into what that meant for them, I thought it was really interesting.
sentences.zh: 当我深入探究这对他们意味着什么时，我觉得非常有趣。

sentences.en: Honestly, as dumb as it sounds, as long as I make enough money to support myself and my fiance, and God willing, us to be able to afford to have children, that's my goal.
sentences.zh: 老实说，尽管听起来很傻，但只要我赚到足够的钱来养活我自己和未婚妻，如果上帝保佑，能让我们养得起孩子，这就是我的目标。

sentences.en: What matters to me is one day I provide for a family.
sentences.zh: 对我很重要的是，有一天我能养家糊口。

sentences.en: It should be my job to provide for her and the family.
sentences.zh: 养活她和这个家本该是我的工作。

sentences.en: It was, they wanted to be able to provide for a family.
sentences.zh: 就是，他们希望能有能力养家糊口。

sentences.en: I should be able to take care of her under one income.
sentences.zh: 我应该靠一份收入就能照顾好她。

sentences.en: And her not have to work because I feel like she shouldn't have to.
sentences.zh: 而且她不必工作，因为我觉得她不应该去工作。

sentences.en: I feel like if she wants to be a stay-at-home mom, she totally can.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果她想当全职妈妈，她完全可以。

sentences.en: Many of these men were, had not yet started families.
sentences.zh: 这些男性中的许多人，都还没有组建家庭。

sentences.en: They were very young.
sentences.zh: 他们非常年轻。

sentences.en: But they had been raised believing that that was their role in society.
sentences.zh: 但他们从小受到的教育让他们相信，那就是他们在社会中的角色。

sentences.en: I feel like in the certain state that we're in as a nation, I feel like that's almost impossible.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在我们国家目前的这种状态下，我觉得这几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: When it comes to the older generation, it's not the same.
sentences.zh: 说到老一辈，情况已经不一样了。

sentences.en: I don't think you could buy a house with two blueberries and a nickel anymore, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想你不能再用两个蓝莓和一个五分硬币买下一栋房子了，你知道的。

sentences.en: It was a dream of mine to own a house.
sentences.zh: 拥有属于自己的房子曾是我的一个梦想。

sentences.en: And I feel like now, now I can't.
sentences.zh: 而我觉得现在，我已经买不起了。

sentences.en: And they felt that in this economy, they couldn't be providers.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得在这种经济环境下，他们无法成为顶梁柱。

sentences.en: I feel like, I feel like you're not a man until, you know, you had to take care of other people.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，我觉得在你不得不照顾别人之前，你都不能算是个真正的男人。

sentences.en: People who financially and emotionally support those around you makes you a man.
sentences.zh: 在经济上和情感上支持你周围的人，这才能让你成为一个真正的男人。

sentences.en: And that really seemed to strike at the core of their identity.
sentences.zh: 这似乎真的触及了他们认同的核心。

sentences.en: I've seen a lot in my little 22 years of life.
sentences.zh: 在我短短22年的人生里，我见过了很多。

sentences.en: I don't think a driver's license makes you a man.
sentences.zh: 我不认为驾驶证能让你成为一个男人。

sentences.en: I don't think serving time in the military makes you a man.
sentences.zh: 我不认为在军队服役能让你成为一个男人。

sentences.en: I don't think doing hard, rigorous work makes you a man.
sentences.zh: 我不认为做辛苦、严苛的工作能让你成为一个男人。

sentences.en: I think when you take responsibility for others, I think that's what makes you a man, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为当你为他人承担责任时，那才是让你成为男人的原因。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's like what it means to be a man traditionally had been built around that.
sentences.zh: 这就好像传统上“什么是男人”的定义就是围绕这一点建立的。

sentences.en: So what happens when you can't make the money and that goes away?
sentences.zh: 所以，当你赚不到钱、这一切不复存在时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so much has changed in nearly half of households with children.
sentences.zh: 近一半有孩子的家庭已经发生了巨大的变化。

sentences.en: Women are the primary breadwinner or are the only breadwinner.
sentences.zh: 女性成了主要的顶梁柱，或者唯一的顶梁柱。

sentences.en: They're single mothers.
sentences.zh: 她们是单身母亲。

sentences.en: That's a huge change from just a few decades ago.
sentences.zh: 与几十年前相比，这是一个巨大的变化。

sentences.en: The script for men really changed.
sentences.zh: 男性的剧本真的变了。

sentences.en: Maybe being the household provider is not their main thing anymore, but they haven't been given a new script.
sentences.zh: 也许成为家庭的顶梁柱不再是他们的主要任务了，但并没有人发给他们一份新剧本。

sentences.en: They didn't feel like there was, you know, a new way that they could contribute to society being offered here.
sentences.zh: 他们并不觉得社会在这里为他们提供了一种可以为之贡献力量的新方式。

sentences.en: So the expectations that these young men have are the same as previous generations, but the reality is different.
sentences.zh: 所以这些年轻男性的期望和前几代人一样，但现实却不同了。

sentences.en: Their reality has changed.
sentences.zh: 他们的现实已经变了。

sentences.en: They can no longer meet those expectations.
sentences.zh: 他们再也无法满足那些期望了。

sentences.en: And as we know, unmet expectations are a principal ingredient of political change.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所知，未能满足的期望是政治变革的主要成分。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then enters Donald Trump talking about providing an economy in which men can do better than they are right now.
sentences.zh: 然后唐纳德·特朗普登场了，他谈到要提供一种让男性能够比现在过得更好的经济环境。

sentences.en: I feel like Trump's going to really be able to fix the issue he's been having with trying to spend millions of dollars elsewhere, financially supporting Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我觉得特朗普真的能够解决他一直在经历的问题，也就是把数百万美元花在其他地方、经济上支持乌克兰的问题。

sentences.en: I feel like he's going to really turn around and focus on America.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他会真正扭转局面，把重点放在美国身上。

sentences.en: When it comes to tax breaks, paying more taxes, I know, especially for corporations.
sentences.zh: 当谈到减税、缴纳更多税款时，我知道，特别是针对企业。

sentences.en: I really believe that it opens up a lot more people to open up more business, so bring a lot more jobs over here.
sentences.zh: 我真的相信这会让更多的人能够开办更多企业，从而把更多的工作岗位带到这里来。

sentences.en: And Trump has this, you know, super macho demeanor.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普有一种，你知道的，超级大男人的派头。

sentences.en: A lot of the men said...
sentences.zh: 许多男性说……

sentences.en: I feel like we were super strong under Trump.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在特朗普领导下我们超级强大。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin didn't invade Ukraine until after Trump left.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京直到特朗普离开后才入侵乌克兰。

sentences.en: They did think it was important for a president to project strength on the world stage, you know, against foreign adversaries.
sentences.zh: 他们确实认为，总统在世界舞台上展现力量是很重要的，你知道的，针对外国对手。

sentences.en: And then we have J.D.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还有J.D.

sentences.en: Vance.
sentences.zh: 万斯。

sentences.en: You know, he's a very smart individual, and I feel like he seems like a really well-put-together guy.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他是一个非常聪明的人，我觉得他看起来是一个非常稳重靠谱的家伙。

sentences.en: Providing this sort of return to traditional families with men as breadwinners and women having lots of kids and taking care of them.
sentences.zh: 这就提供了一种回归传统家庭的可能，由男性作为顶梁柱，女性生很多孩子并照顾他们。

sentences.en: And we have this ticket offering these young men a script to follow, and that was really attractive to them.
sentences.zh: 而我们有这样一张竞选组合，为这些年轻男性提供了一份可以遵循的剧本，这让他们非常着迷。

sentences.en: But the women that we interviewed, they had taken an entirely different message from the last eight years.
sentences.zh: 但我们采访的女性，她们从过去八年中得出的是完全不同的信息。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始游玩。

sentences.en: So, Claire, you said that young women have taken really an entirely different message from the recent years.
sentences.zh: 所以，克莱尔，你说年轻女性从近年来得到了完全不同的信息。

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲这个。

sentences.en: What message did they take?
sentences.zh: 她们接收到了什么信息？

sentences.en: So remember, like we talked about, this was the era when girls were raised to believe that they could do anything, that they could be anything.
sentences.zh: 所以记住，就像我们谈到的，这是一个女孩从小被教育相信自己能做任何事、能成为任何人的时代。

sentences.en: There was almost this idea that the work of feminism had been done and equality had been achieved.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一种看法认为，女权主义的工作已经完成，平等已经实现。

sentences.en: When did you personally start paying attention to politics?
sentences.zh: 你个人是什么时候开始关注政治的？

sentences.en: I would say in 2016.
sentences.zh: 我会说是在2016年。

sentences.en: Definitely had my eyes open in college, I think, because of the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 我想，由于2016年的大选，我在大学里绝对大开眼界。

sentences.en: And then came 2016, which was Donald Trump against Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 然后就迎来了2016年，那是唐纳德·特朗普对阵希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: I was really, really excited.
sentences.zh: 我真的、真的很激动。

sentences.en: I have always really liked Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 我一直非常喜欢希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: I think she's more than qualified.
sentences.zh: 我认为她完全够资格。

sentences.en: She articulates herself very well.
sentences.zh: 她表达能力非常强。

sentences.en: That felt like a real moment where I had some ideas about, yeah, justice and equality and human rights.
sentences.zh: 那感觉像是一个真正的时刻，我对正义、平等和人权有了一些想法。

sentences.en: And then seeing the things that Trump was saying and how people were responding to them at his rallies made me feel very shocked and concerned.
sentences.zh: 然后看到特朗普说的话，以及人们在集会上对这些话的反应，让我感到非常震惊和担忧。

sentences.en: It was just the way that they tore Hillary Clinton down.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们诋毁希拉里·克林顿的方式。

sentences.en: Of course we all remember some of the things that Trump said.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们都记得特朗普说过的一些话。

sentences.en: Just things like she's a disgusting, vile woman.
sentences.zh: 只是一些诸如她是一个令人作呕、极其卑劣的女人之类的话。

sentences.en: And people just started really, really hating on her.
sentences.zh: 人们开始真正、真正地痛恨她。

sentences.en: It's not just Trump.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是特朗普。

sentences.en: It was the conservatives in my life.
sentences.zh: 还有我生活中的保守派。

sentences.en: The way that they would talk about her and insult her.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论她和侮辱她的方式。

sentences.en: It was disturbing to watch.
sentences.zh: 看着这一切令人感到不安。

sentences.en: And there were the Access Hollywood tapes.
sentences.zh: 还有《走进好莱坞》的录音带事件。

sentences.en: Some of the things that he was saying about, you know, grab her by the pussy or like you can say whatever to women.
sentences.zh: 他说的那些话，你知道的，比如“抓住她的下体”或者说你可以对女性说任何话。

sentences.en: And then Hillary Clinton loSt.
sentences.zh: 然后希拉里·克林顿落败了。

sentences.en: Seeing Trump elected made me realize, oh, no, this is how most people feel about, you know, women and people of color in our country.
sentences.zh: 看到特朗普当选让我意识到，哦，不，原来我们国家的大多数人就是这样看待女性和有色人种的。

sentences.en: And that was really disillusioning.
sentences.zh: 那真的让人大失所望。

sentences.en: And in the interviews that we did with these young women, they said that was really a turning point for them.
sentences.zh: 根据我们对这些年轻女性的采访，她们表示这确实是她们人生的一个转折点。

sentences.en: I was 17 that election.
sentences.zh: 那场选举时我17岁。

sentences.en: I was becoming an adult, like literally about to turn 17.
sentences.zh: 我正在长大成人，字面意思上马上就要17岁了。

sentences.en: I wasn't old enough to vote, but I was old enough to watch what was going on during that election.
sentences.zh: 我当时年龄还不到投票的时候，但我已经到了可以关注那场选举中发生的事情的年纪。

sentences.en: Seeing things change in such a huge way at this time definitely opened my eyes politically and made me understand that I had things to be angry about.
sentences.zh: 在这个时期看到事物发生如此巨大的变化，绝对在政治上开阔了我的眼界，让我明白了我有很多需要愤怒的事情。

sentences.en: And political science has shown us that what happens politically when you're around 18 is really formative in your views.
sentences.zh: 政治学研究表明，当你18岁左右时，政治上发生的事情对你的观点具有真正的塑造作用。

sentences.en: And this is what these women experienced.
sentences.zh: 而这就是这些女性所经历的。

sentences.en: And then.
sentences.zh: 然后。

sentences.en: Also, me too, I think was a big moment.
sentences.zh: 还有，“我也是”运动，我认为也是一个重大的时刻。

sentences.en: Soon after Donald Trump was elected, the Me Too movement happened.
sentences.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普当选后不久，“我也是”运动就爆发了。

sentences.en: I personally identified with Me Too because me too, you know, and I feel like everyone I know has a story.
sentences.zh: 我个人对“我也是”运动很有共鸣，因为我也是，你知道的，而且我觉得我认识的每个人都有这样的故事。

sentences.en: Which was, of course, spurred on by the revelations about Harvey Weinstein,
sentences.zh: 当然，这主要是由哈维·韦恩斯坦的丑闻所激发的，

sentences.en: but led to this realization that sexual harassment and sexual assault in the workplace was really quite common.
sentences.zh: 但也让人意识到，职场上的性骚扰和性侵犯其实非常普遍。

sentences.en: As a young girl with a Twitter account, it was really grounding to understand that some of the harassment maybe that I'd experienced, even at a really young age,
sentences.zh: 作为一个拥有推特账号的年轻女孩，能够明白我所经历的一些骚扰——甚至是在很小的时候——

sentences.en: wasn't just something that I was experiencing.
sentences.zh: 并不仅仅是我一个人在经历，这让我感到很踏实。

sentences.en: And the women that I talked to, you know, said that this continued to be this shock for them.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的女性也说，你知道的，这持续给她们带来了一种震撼。

sentences.en: Seeing online, oh, this is something that can happen to you at any age.
sentences.zh: 在网上看到，哦，原来这种事在任何年龄都可能发生在你身上。

sentences.en: And it's kind of just part of the experience of being a woman.
sentences.zh: 而且这某种程度上只是身为女性经历的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, they were entering the real world.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她们正在步入现实世界。

sentences.en: They were becoming adults at a time when it was becoming extremely clear that, in fact,
sentences.zh: 她们正在长大成人，而此时情况变得极其明朗，那就是——

sentences.en: sexism was not in the least a thing of the past and that the world was not at all the way that they were told it would be.
sentences.zh: 性别歧视绝非过去式，世界也根本不是别人告诉她们的那样。

sentences.en: Okay, so the next event in the political calendar that is likely, I imagine, to be meaningful to the women you talk to was the Dobbs abortion case, right?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么政治日历上的下一个事件，我想对你采访的女性来说也是意义重大的，就是多布斯堕胎案，对吧？

sentences.en: June 2022, when the Federal Protection for Abortion went away.
sentences.zh: 2022年6月，联邦对堕胎权的保护不复存在了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I remember for years interviewing young women and they didn't really think that much about abortion or talk that much about abortion.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我记得多年来采访年轻女性时，她们其实并不怎么考虑堕胎，也不怎么谈论堕胎。

sentences.en: But as soon as Roe fell, suddenly this was really a big issue for them.
sentences.zh: 但罗诉韦德案一倒台，突然之间这成了她们非常关心的大问题。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I'd write about Roe v.
sentences.zh: 我曾在历史书上读到过罗诉韦德案，

sentences.en: Wade in history books and kind of thought to myself, wow, that's so crazy.
sentences.zh: 当时心里还想，哇，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Well, that feels like just a given.
sentences.zh: 嗯，感觉那就像是理所当然的事。

sentences.en: Anybody can get an abortion.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以堕胎。

sentences.en: Oh, I was shocked, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 哦，说实话，我当时震惊了。

sentences.en: I never thought that it was actually on the table.
sentences.zh: 我从来没想过这件事居然会被摆上台面讨论。

sentences.en: Seeing American history go backwards was really surreal.
sentences.zh: 看着美国历史开倒车，真的非常超现实。

sentences.en: This was the thing that took them from their eyes being opened about women's rights and the unfinished work of feminism to really connecting it to political activism.
sentences.zh: 正是这件事，让她们从对女性权利和女权主义未竟事业的眼界大开，转变为真正将之与政治行动主义联系起来。

sentences.en: Like, okay, if the president, whoever was president got us into this mess, maybe the next president could get us out of it.
sentences.zh: 比如，好吧，如果总统——无论哪个总统——把我们带进了这个烂摊子，也许下一位总统能把我们带出来。

sentences.en: They told me that this was the first time, you know, as young adults, that they realized who you vote for could have a direct impact on your rights.
sentences.zh: 她们告诉我，这是她们作为年轻人第一次意识到，你把票投给谁，会对你的权利产生直接影响。

sentences.en: The political climate towards women is scary.
sentences.zh: 针对女性的政治气候令人担忧。

sentences.en: I feel like it's kind of it's an attack on women, to be completely honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我觉得这简直是对女性的攻击。

sentences.en: And they said it made them realize that, as one woman told me, Donald Trump's words, people sometimes say that he just talks and that he doesn't mean them.
sentences.zh: 她们说这让她们意识到，正如一位女性对我说的那样，唐纳德·特朗普说的话，人们有时会说他只是随口说说，并不是认真的。

sentences.en: And that Dobbs was a clear example of how words can have real life effects.
sentences.zh: 而多布斯案就是一个清晰的例子，说明言论是如何产生现实影响的。

sentences.en: And it also made me think, wow, if we can roll this back, what else could change?
sentences.zh: 这也让我想到，哇，如果我们能开倒车取消这个，那还有什么不能改变的？

sentences.en: I really do think, like, if we give them room to make more decisions, like, they'll come after birth control next.
sentences.zh: 我真的觉得，如果我们给他们空间做出更多决定，他们接下来就会对避孕措施下手。

sentences.en: As much as, you know, I believe women are equal, does the rest of the world, do the people in power feel that way?
sentences.zh: 尽管我知道女性生而平等，但这个世界的其他人、掌权者也是这么想的吗？

sentences.en: Because it doesn't feel that way right now.
sentences.zh: 因为现在感觉并不像这样。

sentences.en: They said that they had always been inclined to vote Democratic.
sentences.zh: 她们说自己一直倾向于投票给民主党。

sentences.en: I've definitely gone more and more to the left.
sentences.zh: 我确实越来越向左翼靠拢了。

sentences.en: But it had moved them much further to the left.
sentences.zh: 但这把她们推得更向左了。

sentences.en: My dad would say things like, OK, well, just wait.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸会说这样的话，比如，好吧，等着瞧吧。

sentences.en: You're going to become more conservative the older that you get.
sentences.zh: 你越老就会变得越保守。

sentences.en: And I'm, like, waiting because I'm older and I feel more progressive than I was then.
sentences.zh: 而我在等啊等，因为我年纪更大了，却觉得自己比当时更进步了。

sentences.en: At one point in time, I would probably take more of, I wouldn't say, like, a middle view, but closer to the middle, to where I could see the other party's point of view.
sentences.zh: 曾经有一段时间，我可能会采取一种——我不会说是中间派的观点，但更接近中间派，以至于我能理解另一党的观点。

sentences.en: But at this point in time, no, I can't.
sentences.zh: 但现在这个时候，不，我不能。

sentences.en: I can't.
sentences.zh: 我做不到。

sentences.en: With the way that they have conducted themselves, it just pushed me further against what the Republican Party believes.
sentences.zh: 就他们的行事作风而言，这只会把我推得更加反对共和党的信仰。

sentences.en: And this is true on abortion.
sentences.zh: 这在堕胎问题上尤为如此。

sentences.en: This is the big driver for them.
sentences.zh: 这是推动她们的核心动力。

sentences.en: But interestingly, it's not just abortion or the so-called women's issues.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，不仅仅是堕胎或所谓的女性议题。

sentences.en: They also moved to the left on climate.
sentences.zh: 她们在气候问题上也向左转了。

sentences.en: They moved to the left on guns.
sentences.zh: 她们在枪支问题上也向左转了。

sentences.en: They moved to the left on race relations.
sentences.zh: 她们在种族关系上也向左转了。

sentences.en: Dobbs was this turning point that really made this generation of young women more liberal than anyone else in America today.
sentences.zh: 多布斯案是一个转折点，它真正让这一代年轻女性比当今美国其他任何人都要更加自由派。

sentences.en: And do we know why on those other things as well, Claire?
sentences.zh: 克莱尔，那我们在其他方面也知道原因吗？

sentences.en: Why is it such a clean sweep?
sentences.zh: 为什么会是如此全面的转向？

sentences.en: Political scientists say they're not exactly sure.
sentences.zh: 政治学家表示他们也不是很确定。

sentences.en: Once people really start to think about their political identities, they apply it, obviously, not just to one issue, but to more issues.
sentences.zh: 一旦人们真正开始思考自己的政治身份，他们显然不仅将其应用于一个问题，而是应用于更多问题。

sentences.en: Gun control activists, high schoolers, a lot of that movement was really led by women.
sentences.zh: 控枪活动人士、高中生，这一运动很大程度上都是由女性领导的。

sentences.en: There is an idea in general that men vote more on economic issues and that women vote more on issues that have to do with social well-being.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍有一种看法，即男性更多地基于经济议题投票，而女性更多地基于与社会福祉相关的议题投票。

sentences.en: And so that could be a reason that climate and guns have also, you know, become issues that young women are focused on.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能就是气候和枪支也成为年轻女性关注焦点的一个原因。

sentences.en: But really, the political scientists that I talked to said it's just evidence of the ways in which this group of people is moving to the left across the board.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，与我交谈过的政治学家表示，这只是这群人在各个方面全面向左转的证据。

sentences.en: And Kamala Harris is presumably benefiting from this move.
sentences.zh: 而卡玛拉·哈里斯大概正在从这种转变中受益。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the young women that I talked to.
sentences.zh: 还有我交谈过的那些年轻女性。

sentences.en: Honestly, I feel really excited to vote for a woman for the first time.
sentences.zh: 说实话，能够第一次把票投给一位女性，我感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: She is concerned about women's rights.
sentences.zh: 她关心女性权利。

sentences.en: That's like, you know, at the forefront.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，你知道的，处于最前沿。

sentences.en: They had felt so energized by these issues that we've been discussing.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在讨论的这些议题让她们感到非常振奋。

sentences.en: Just getting on TikTok, you're seeing everyone ramped up.
sentences.zh: 只要打开TikTok，你就会看到每个人都斗志昂扬。

sentences.en: They had not felt super energized by Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 她们并没有被乔·拜登极大地鼓舞。

sentences.en: They feel very differently about Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 她们对卡玛拉·哈里斯的看法完全不同。

sentences.en: I don't think that it had felt that exciting since Obama, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，自奥巴马以来，我好久没觉得这么令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: I do feel honestly just a bit excited to be a part of history.
sentences.zh: 说实话，能成为历史的一部分，我确实感到有点兴奋。

sentences.en: OK, so both parties are tapping into these big social and economic and cultural changes that are running deep beneath the politics.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以两党都在顺应这些深刻植根于政治之下的重大社会、经济和文化变革。

sentences.en: And given that this is such a deep thing and that young voters are so different now on the political front, what does this mean for these young people and their futures?
sentences.zh: 鉴于这是一个如此深刻的问题，而且年轻选民在政治前沿现在有了如此大的不同，这对这些年轻人及其未来意味着什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Young men and young women are moving in different directions, diverging from one another in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 年轻男性和年轻女性正朝着不同的方向发展，在许多方面彼此分道扬镳。

sentences.en: It's politics.
sentences.zh: 涉及政治。

sentences.en: It's education.
sentences.zh: 涉及教育。

sentences.en: It's religion.
sentences.zh: 涉及宗教。

sentences.en: Men are more likely than their female peers to go to church now, which is a surprising new development.
sentences.zh: 如今，男性比同龄女性更有可能去教堂，这是一个令人惊讶的新动向。

sentences.en: It's media.
sentences.zh: 涉及媒体。

sentences.en: It's media.
sentences.zh: 涉及媒体。

sentences.en: They're consuming, you know, sometimes entirely different media from different sources.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们有时在消费来自不同来源的完全不同的媒体。

sentences.en: And so they're really beginning to live sort of different lives in a lot of areas.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们在许多领域确实开始过上某种截然不同的生活。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't use dating apps anymore.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不再使用约会软件了。

sentences.en: But back when I did have one, I mean, like the amount of women that were like, if you voted for Trump, don't even talk to me.
sentences.zh: 但当年我用的时候，我的意思是，有多少女性会说：“如果你投了特朗普的票，就别跟我说话。”

sentences.en: And I'm like, OK, and we know that in this era of increasing political polarization, people have become less likely to date people who disagree with them politically.
sentences.zh: 而我想说，好的。我们知道，在这个日益政治极化的时代，人们与政治观点不合的人约会的可能性已经降低了。

sentences.en: I think that even if you're a man who's voting for Trump only for the economy, you have to turn a blind eye to a lot of other issues.
sentences.zh: 我认为，即使你是一个仅仅为了经济而投票给特朗普的男性，你也必须对许多其他问题视而不见。

sentences.en: And I would not date a man who thinks like that.
sentences.zh: 而我不会和这样想的男性约会。

sentences.en: That didn't used to be a thing.
sentences.zh: 这过去并不是一回事。

sentences.en: It's becoming more of a thing.
sentences.zh: 现在这越来越成为一回事了。

sentences.en: So I think it probably does affect the way that they think about who's going to be in their future and how they form families and what they're looking for from one another.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这可能会影响他们对未来伴侣人选的看法、他们如何组建家庭以及他们对彼此的期望。

sentences.en: But interestingly, you know, many of the young men we talked to said they were leaning toward Trump because they thought he would be better on the economy.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，你知道的，我们采访的许多年轻男性表示他们倾向于特朗普，因为他们认为他在经济方面会表现得更好。

sentences.en: And in part, they were prioritizing the economy as an issue because they felt this need to be a provider, to buy a home.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们把经济作为一个优先议题，是因为他们感到需要成为顶梁柱，需要买得起房。

sentences.en: You know, these things that were really bound up in their sense of what they wanted for themselves.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些事情深深扎根于他们对自己想要的生活的认知中。

sentences.en: And I'm just curious what you think of that logic.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你对这种逻辑有什么看法。

sentences.en: I understand it, if I'm being honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我能理解。

sentences.en: I'm trying to give the boys a little bit of grace here.
sentences.zh: 我正试着对这些男生多一点宽容。

sentences.en: The thing is, I'm deeply empathetic to it because I've been taught that being a man means being a provider.
sentences.zh: 问题是，我对此深感共情，因为我被教导说，身为男性就意味着要成为顶梁柱。

sentences.en: Men are taught, like, you bring home more money.
sentences.zh: 男性受到的教育是，你要带回更多的钱。

sentences.en: You are head of household.
sentences.zh: 你是家里的顶梁柱。

sentences.en: Some of the women that we talked to said, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们采访的一些女性说，你知道的，

sentences.en: they were empathetic to men's changing roles and this notion that they had wanted to be a provider and now they didn't know what their role was.
sentences.zh: 她们对男性角色的转变以及这种观念表示理解，即他们曾想成为顶梁柱，而现在却不知道自己的角色是什么了。

sentences.en: If I really do, like, a searching moral inventory, I would probably have to reckon with making more money than my partner.
sentences.zh: 如果我真的进行一次深刻的道德反省，我可能不得不去接受我赚的钱比伴侣多这一事实。

sentences.en: That's just something that I would need to get over.
sentences.zh: 这只是我需要克服的一个坎。

sentences.en: Some of them acknowledged how deep-seated some of these expectations for men still were.
sentences.zh: 她们中的一些人承认，对男性的这些期望根深蒂固到什么程度。

sentences.en: I think it's important, yeah, for them to provide for their family, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很重要，是的，对他们来说养家糊口，绝对如此。

sentences.en: To be the sole provider, no.
sentences.zh: 要成为唯一的经济支柱？不。

sentences.en: And they told us that they absolutely wanted partners who would contribute to the household, but...
sentences.zh: 她们告诉我们，她们绝对想要会为家庭做贡献的伴侣，但是……

sentences.en: The world is too modern now for the man to have to be the provider.
sentences.zh: 现在的世界太现代了，不需要男性非得成为顶梁柱。

sentences.en: I'll speak from, like, my own personal experience right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在以我自己的亲身经历来说。

sentences.en: I'm the main provider.
sentences.zh: 我是主要的经济支柱。

sentences.en: You know, I make more than my partner.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我赚得比伴侣多。

sentences.en: And I don't mind it at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不介意。

sentences.en: I'm like, you sit pretty.
sentences.zh: 我会说，你美美地享受就行。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: The idea of being a sole provider for a woman and their children was outdated, but, you know, they could see where these men were coming from.
sentences.zh: 那种认为女性及其孩子全靠丈夫一人养家的想法已经过时了，但你知道的，她们能理解这些男性的立场。

sentences.en: My fiancé is conservative.
sentences.zh: 我的未婚夫是保守派。

sentences.en: Eye roll.
sentences.zh: （翻了个白眼）

sentences.en: Oh, interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's voting for Trump.
sentences.zh: 对，他投了特朗普的票。

sentences.en: Some of the young voters that we interviewed were even in relationships with people voting for the opposite candidate.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的一些年轻选民甚至在和投票给对立候选人的人谈恋爱。

sentences.en: I do have a girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 我确实有个女朋友。

sentences.en: She's a liberal.
sentences.zh: 她是自由派。

sentences.en: She is very pro-choice.
sentences.zh: 她非常支持堕胎权。

sentences.en: She does not like Trump.
sentences.zh: 她不喜欢特朗普。

sentences.en: So our dynamic is super weird.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的相处模式超级诡异。

sentences.en: We can't really talk politics, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我们真的没法聊政治。

sentences.en: We try, but I just, I can't see his point of view.
sentences.zh: 我们尝试过，但我就是——我无法理解他的观点。

sentences.en: Are you dating anyone right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在谈恋爱吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Do you want to be dating someone?
sentences.zh: 你想谈恋爱吗？

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Secretary of State Antony Blinken, on his 11th trip to the Middle East since the war with Hamas began last year, pressed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，自去年与哈马斯的战争爆发以来第11次访问中东的国务卿安东尼·布林肯，敦促以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡

sentences.en: quote, capitalize on the killing of the Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar and end the war in the Gaza Strip.

sentences.en: Netanyahu, in a statement, emphasized the need to fight Hezbollah, Hamas, and Iran, but did not mention a truce.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在声明中强调了打击真主党、哈马斯和伊朗的必要性，但并未提及休战。

sentences.en: And Michael Jeffries, the former longtime chief executive of Abercrombie & Fitch,
sentences.zh: 曾长期担任阿伯克罗比和费奇公司首席执行官的迈克尔·杰弗里斯，

sentences.zh: 被起诉在公司任职期间经营国际性贩运犯罪网络的罪名。

sentences.en: The indictment includes accusations from 15 people who said that they had been coerced into sex acts.

sentences.en: It echoes allegations first unearthed last year by a BBC investigation and a class-action lawsuit,
sentences.zh: 这呼应了英国广播公司调查和集体诉讼去年首次揭露的指控，

sentences.en: Jeffries and his partner, Matthew Smith, were arrested in Florida on Tuesday.
